svg.title: The truth is fixed before the LLM writes
svg.desc: The five steps of the benchmark generator. Code and a seed sample the case, with one of the report templates, and write the truth file. An LLM writes the report's free text, code fills the template's HTML with the truth and that text, and Chrome renders it as a PDF. check.py compares the PDF text with the truth file, and a case that fails is written again. The PDFs that pass are scanned at two levels with Pillow and copied as clean images, so each report comes as a native, scan, fax, mixed or image PDF, all with one truth file.

3. Render the PDF

4. Check against the truth

5. Scan
